mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an open-concept kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor for an open-concept kitchen remodel involves reviewing their portfolio, checking references, and ensuring they have specific experience with structural modifications. Look for a contractor who demonstrates strong communication skills and provides a detailed, transparent estimate. A preparation step is to clarify your vision and budget upfront and ask how they handle unexpected issues or changes during the project. This ensures alignment and helps prevent misunderstandings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in structural modifications, check references, and ensure clear communication. Clarify your vision and budget upfront for a smooth project.
